question: Regarding the DNA structure

options.opb: The nitrogenous bases are oriented towards the outside.
options.opc: The monomeric components are linked by glycosidic bonds.
options.opd: It is stabilized by hydrogen bonds between different chains.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: DNA contains deoxyribose sugar -> The nitrogenous bases are oriented towards the inside -> The monomeric components are linked by phosphodiester bonds -> It is stabilized by hydrogen bonds between complementary base pairs -> 95%

CHAIN: DNA contains deoxyribose sugar -> The nitrogenous bases are oriented towards the inside -> The monomeric components are linked by phosphodiester bonds -> Hydrogen bonds form between adenine-thymine and guanine-cytosine base pairs -> 90%
analysis: DNA structure consists of deoxyribose sugar, and the nitrogenous bases are oriented towards the inside of the double helix. The monomeric components (nucleotides) are linked by phosphodiester bonds. Hydrogen bonds stabilize the interaction between nitrogenous bases in the double helix.
